live.canon|ezekiel|1:1: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of Elohim (God).
live.canon|ezekiel|1:2: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,
live.canon|ezekiel|1:3: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of Yahuah (LORD) was there upon him.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:4: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:5: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:6: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:7: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:8: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:9: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:10: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.

live.canon|ezekiel|1:12: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:13: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

live.canon|ezekiel|1:15: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:16: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:17: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:18: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:19: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:20: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
live.canon|ezekiel|1:21: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

live.canon|ezekiel|3:18: When I say unto the wicked, You shall surely die; and you give him not warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at your hand.
live.canon|ezekiel|3:19: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.
live.canon|ezekiel|3:20: Again, When a righteous man does turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because you have not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he has done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at your hand.
live.canon|ezekiel|3:21: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he does not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also you have delivered your soul.

live.canon|ezekiel|3:27: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); He that hears, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.

live.canon|ezekiel|5:7: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you multiplied more than the nations that are round about you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you;
live.canon|ezekiel|5:8: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I, even I, am against you, and will execute judgments in the midst of you in the sight of the nations.
live.canon|ezekiel|5:9: And I will do in you that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all your abominations.
live.canon|ezekiel|5:10: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of you, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in you, and the whole remnant of you will I scatter into all the winds.
live.canon|ezekiel|5:11: Wherefore, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore will I also diminish you; neither shall my eye spare, neither will I have any pity.
live.canon|ezekiel|5:12: A third part of you shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of you: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about you; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.

live.canon|ezekiel|6:11: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Smite with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
live.canon|ezekiel|6:12: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remains and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.

live.canon|ezekiel|6:5: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.

live.canon|ezekiel|6:7: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).

live.canon|ezekiel|7:3: Now is the end come upon you, and I will send my anger upon you, and will judge you according to your ways, and will recompense upon you all your abominations.
live.canon|ezekiel|7:4: And my eye shall not spare you, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense your ways upon you, and your abominations shall be in the midst of you: and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).

live.canon|ezekiel|7:6: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for you; behold, it is come.
live.canon|ezekiel|7:7: The morning is come unto you, O you that dwell in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.

live.canon|ezekiel|7:9: And my eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense you according to your ways and your abominations that are in the midst of you; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD) that smites.

live.canon|ezekiel|8:1: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Yahudah (Judah) sat before me, that the hand of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) fell there upon me.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:3: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of Elohim (God) to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looks toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:5: Then said he unto me, Son of Adam, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:6: He said furthermore unto me, Son of Adam, see you what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Yashar'el (Israel) commits here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn you yet again, and you shall see greater abominations.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:12: Then said he unto me, Son of Adam, have you seen what the ancients of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, Yahuah (LORD) sees us not; Yahuah (LORD) has forsaken the earth.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:15: Then said he unto me, Have you seen this, O son of Adam? turn you yet again, and you shall see greater abominations than these.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:17: Then he said unto me, Have you seen this, O son of Adam? Is it a light thing to the house of Yahudah (Judah) that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:18: Therefore will I also deal in fury: my eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:2: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:4: And, behold, the glory of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:7: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:8: Then said he unto me, Son of Adam, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:9: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:10: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), pourtrayed upon the wall round about.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:11: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:14: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’S house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:16: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD’S house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of Yahuah (LORD), between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of Yahuah (LORD), and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.
live.canon|ezekiel|8:13: He said also unto me, Turn you yet again, and you shall see greater abominations that they do.
live.canon|ezekiel|9:1: He cried also in my ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.
live.canon|ezekiel|9:2: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lies toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them was clothed with linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.
live.canon|ezekiel|9:5: And to the others he said in my hearing, Go you after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have you pity:
live.canon|ezekiel|9:11: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as you have commanded me.
live.canon|ezekiel|9:3: And the glory of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer’s inkhorn by his side;
live.canon|ezekiel|9:4: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.
live.canon|ezekiel|9:6: Slay utterly old and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house.
live.canon|ezekiel|9:7: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go you forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.
live.canon|ezekiel|9:9: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah) is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, Yahuah (LORD) has forsaken the earth, and Yahuah (LORD) sees not.
live.canon|ezekiel|9:10: And as for me also, my eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will recompense their way upon their head.
live.canon|ezekiel|9:8: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Adonai (Lord) GOD! will you destroy all the residue of Yashar'el (Israel) in your pouring out of your fury upon Jerusalem?
live.canon|ezekiel|10:2: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill your hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:5: And the sound of the cherubims’ wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the El Shaddai (Almighty God) when he speaks.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:1: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:3: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:4: Then the glory of Yahuah (LORD) went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’S glory.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:6: And it came to pass, that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:7: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen: who took it, and went out.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:8: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man’s hand under their wings.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:9: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:10: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:11: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:12: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:13: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:14: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:15: And the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:16: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:17: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:18: Then the glory of Yahuah (LORD) departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:19: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’S house; and the glory of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) was over them above.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:20: This is the living creature that I saw under the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:21: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
live.canon|ezekiel|10:22: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:1: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD’S house, which looks eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:5: And the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Thus have you said, O house of Yashar'el (Israel): for I know the things that come into your mind, every one of them.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:6: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled the streets thereof with the slain.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:7: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Your slain whom you have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:10: You shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Yashar'el (Israel); and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|11:11: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall you be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Yashar'el (Israel):
live.canon|ezekiel|11:12: And you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD): for you have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:15: Son of Adam, your brethren, even your brethren, the men of your kindred, and all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from Yahuah (LORD): unto us is this land given in possession.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:16: Therefore say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:17: Therefore say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|ezekiel|11:20: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their Elohim (God).
live.canon|ezekiel|11:21: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|11:2: Then said he unto me, Son of Adam, these are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:
live.canon|ezekiel|11:3: Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:4: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of Adam.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:9: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:8: You have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|11:14: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|11:18: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:19: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
live.canon|ezekiel|11:22: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) was over them above.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:23: And the glory of Yahuah (LORD) went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:24: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of Elohim (God) into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:25: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that Yahuah (LORD) had shewed me.
live.canon|ezekiel|11:13: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Adonai (Lord) GOD! will you make a full end of the remnant of Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.canon|ezekiel|12:2: Son of Adam, you dwell in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:3: Therefore, you son of Adam, prepare you stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and you shall remove from your place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:4: Then shall you bring forth your stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and you shall go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:5: Dig you through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:6: In their sight shall you bear it upon your shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: you shall cover your face, that you see not the ground: for I have set you for a sign unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|ezekiel|12:7: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with my hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:9: Son of Adam, has not the house of Yashar'el (Israel), the rebellious house, said unto you, What do you?
live.canon|ezekiel|12:10: Say you unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) that are among them.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:18: Son of Adam, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with carefulness;
live.canon|ezekiel|12:19: And say unto the people of the land, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and of the land of Yashar'el (Israel); They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:28: Therefore say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|12:1: The word of Yahuah (LORD) also came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|12:8: And in the morning came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|12:11: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:12: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:13: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:14: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:15: And they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:16: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|12:17: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|12:21: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|12:20: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|12:22: Son of Adam, what is that proverb that you have in the land of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision fails?
live.canon|ezekiel|12:23: Tell them therefore, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Yashar'el (Israel); but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:25: For I am Yahuah (LORD): I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|12:27: Son of Adam, behold, they of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) say, The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of the times that are far off.
live.canon|ezekiel|12:24: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|ezekiel|12:26: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|13:2: Son of Adam, prophesy against the prophets of Yashar'el (Israel) that prophesy, and say you unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD);
live.canon|ezekiel|13:3: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
live.canon|ezekiel|13:4: O Yashar'el (Israel), your prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
live.canon|ezekiel|13:5: You have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Yashar'el (Israel) to stand in the battle in the day of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|13:6: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, Yahuah (LORD) says: and Yahuah (LORD) has not sent them: and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word.
live.canon|ezekiel|13:7: Have you not seen a vain vision, and have you not spoken a lying divination, whereas you say, Yahuah (LORD) says it; albeit I have not spoken?
live.canon|ezekiel|13:8: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|13:9: And my hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), neither shall they enter into the land of Yashar'el (Israel); and you shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|13:11: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and you, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.
live.canon|ezekiel|13:12: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith you have daubed it?
live.canon|ezekiel|13:13: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it.
live.canon|ezekiel|13:14: So will I break down the wall that you have daubed with untempered morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and you shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|13:16: To wit, the prophets of Yashar'el (Israel) which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|13:17: Likewise, you son of Adam, set your face against the daughters of your people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy you against them,
live.canon|ezekiel|13:18: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people, and will you save the souls alive that come unto you?
live.canon|ezekiel|13:19: And will you pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?
live.canon|ezekiel|13:20: Wherefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith you there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that you hunt to make them fly.
live.canon|ezekiel|13:21: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|13:22: Because with lies you have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:
live.canon|ezekiel|13:23: Therefore you shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|13:1: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|13:10: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:
live.canon|ezekiel|13:15: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered morter, and will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;
live.canon|ezekiel|14:6: Therefore say unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
live.canon|ezekiel|14:7: For every one of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the stranger that sojourns in Yashar'el (Israel), which separateth himself from me, and sets up his idols in his heart, and puts the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and comes to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I Yahuah (LORD) will answer him by myself:
live.canon|ezekiel|14:8: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|14:9: And if the prophet be deceived when he has spoken a thing, I Yahuah (LORD) have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|ezekiel|14:10: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeks unto him;
live.canon|ezekiel|14:11: That the house of Yashar'el (Israel) may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their Elohim (God), says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|14:13: Son of Adam, when the land sins against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out my hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:
live.canon|ezekiel|14:14: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|14:16: Though these three men were in it, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.
live.canon|ezekiel|14:18: Though these three men were in it, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.
live.canon|ezekiel|14:20: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
live.canon|ezekiel|14:21: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?
live.canon|ezekiel|14:22: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and you shall see their way and their doings: and you shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.
live.canon|ezekiel|14:23: And they shall comfort you, when you see their ways and their doings: and you shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|14:1: Then came certain of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel) unto me, and sat before me.
live.canon|ezekiel|14:2: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|14:3: Son of Adam, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?
live.canon|ezekiel|14:5: That I may take the house of Yashar'el (Israel) in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
live.canon|ezekiel|14:4: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Every man of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) that sets up his idols in his heart, and puts the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet; I Yahuah (LORD) will answer him that comes according to the multitude of his idols;
live.canon|ezekiel|14:12: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again to me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|14:15: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:
live.canon|ezekiel|14:17: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:
live.canon|ezekiel|14:19: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:
live.canon|ezekiel|15:4: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devours both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?
live.canon|ezekiel|15:5: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire has devoured it, and it is burned?
live.canon|ezekiel|15:6: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
live.canon|ezekiel|15:7: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one fire, and another fire shall devour them; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I set my face against them.
live.canon|ezekiel|15:8: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|15:1: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|15:2: Son of Adam, What is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
live.canon|ezekiel|15:3: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
live.canon|ezekiel|16:3: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) unto Jerusalem; Your birth and your nativity is of the land of Canaan; your father was an Amorite, and your mother an Hittite.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:4: And as for your nativity, in the day you were born your navel was not cut, neither were you washed in water to supple you; you were not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:5: None eye pitied you, to do any of these unto you, to have compassion upon you; but you were cast out in the open field, to the lothing of your person, in the day that you were born.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:11: I decked you also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon your hands, and a chain on your neck.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:12: And I put a jewel on your forehead, and earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown upon your head.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:13: Thus were you decked with gold and silver; and your raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; you did eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and you were exceeding beautiful, and you did prosper into a kingdom.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:14: And your renown went forth among the heathen for your beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|16:15: But you did trust in your own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of your renown, and pouredst out your fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:16: And of your garments you did take, and deckedst your high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:17: You have also taken your fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made to thyself images of men, and did commit whoredom with them,
live.canon|ezekiel|16:18: And tookest your broidered garments, and coveredst them: and you have set my oil and my incense before them.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:19: My meat also which I gave you, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed you, you have even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|16:20: Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne unto me, and these have you sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of your whoredoms a small matter,
live.canon|ezekiel|16:21: That you have slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?
live.canon|ezekiel|16:22: And in all your abominations and your whoredoms you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were polluted in your blood.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:23: And it came to pass after all your wickedness, (woe, woe unto you! says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD);)
live.canon|ezekiel|16:24: That you have also built unto you an eminent place, and have made you an high place in every street.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:25: You have built your high place at every head of the way, and have made your beauty to be abhorred, and have opened your feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied your whoredoms.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:26: You have also committed fornication with the Egyptians your neighbours, great of flesh; and have increased your whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:27: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your ordinary food, and delivered you unto the will of them that hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of your lewd way.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:28: You have played the whore also with the Assyrians, because you were unsatiable; yea, you have played the harlot with them, and yet could not be satisfied.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:29: You have moreover multiplied your fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet you were not satisfied herewith.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:30: How weak is your heart, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), seeing you do all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
live.canon|ezekiel|16:31: In that you buildest your eminent place in the head of every way, and make your high place in every street; and have not been as an harlot, in that you scornest hire;
live.canon|ezekiel|16:32: But as a wife that commits adultery, which takes strangers instead of her husband!
live.canon|ezekiel|16:33: They give gifts to all whores: but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto you on every side for your whoredom.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:34: And the contrary is in you from other women in your whoredoms, whereas none follows you to commit whoredoms: and in that you give a reward, and no reward is given unto you, therefore you are contrary.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:36: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness discovered through your whoredoms with your lovers, and with all the idols of your abominations, and by the blood of your children, which you did give unto them;
live.canon|ezekiel|16:37: Behold, therefore I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all them that you have loved, with all them that you have hated; I will even gather them round about against you, and will discover your nakedness unto them, that they may see all your nakedness.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:38: And I will judge you, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give you blood in fury and jealousy.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:41: And they shall burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments upon you in the sight of many women: and I will cause you to cease from playing the harlot, and you also shall give no hire any more.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:42: So will I make my fury toward you to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from you, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:43: Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense your way upon your head, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): and you shall not commit this lewdness above all your abominations.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:44: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against you, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:45: You are your mother’s daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:46: And your elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at your left hand: and your younger sister, that dwells at your right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:47: Yet have you not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, you were corrupted more than they in all your ways.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:48: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:49: Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:51: Neither has Samaria committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters in all your abominations which you have done.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:52: You also, which have judged your sisters, bear your own shame for your sins that you have committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than you: yea, be you confounded also, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:53: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of your captives in the midst of them:
live.canon|ezekiel|16:54: That you may bear your own shame, and may be confounded in all that you have done, in that you are a comfort unto them.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:55: When your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then you and your daughters shall return to your former estate.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:56: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,
live.canon|ezekiel|16:57: Before your wickedness was discovered, as at the time of your reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise you round about.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:58: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|16:59: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will even deal with you as you have done, which have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:60: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish unto you an everlasting covenant.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:61: Then you shall remember your ways, and be ashamed, when you shall receive your sisters, your elder and your younger: and I will give them unto you for daughters, but not by your covenant.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:62: And I will establish my covenant with you; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|ezekiel|16:63: That you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I am pacified toward you for all that you have done, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|16:1: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|16:2: Son of Adam, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
live.canon|ezekiel|16:9: Then washed I you with water; yea, I throughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:6: And when I passed by you, and saw you polluted in your own blood, I said unto you when you were in your blood, Live; yea, I said unto you when you were in your blood, Live.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:7: I have caused you to multiply as the bud of the field, and you have increased and waxen great, and you are come to excellent ornaments: your breasts are fashioned, and your hair is grown, whereas you were naked and bare.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:8: Now when I passed by you, and looked upon you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over you, and covered your nakedness: yea, I sware unto you, and entered into a covenant with you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), and you becamest mine.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:10: I clothed you also with broidered work, and shod you with badgers’ skin, and I girded you about with fine linen, and I covered you with silk.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:35: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|ezekiel|16:39: And I will also give you into their hand, and they shall throw down your eminent place, and shall break down your high places: they shall strip you also of your clothes, and shall take your fair jewels, and leave you naked and bare.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:40: They shall also bring up a company against you, and they shall stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.
live.canon|ezekiel|16:50: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:3: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:
live.canon|ezekiel|17:9: Say you, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:10: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind touches it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:19: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); As I live, surely my oath that he has despised, and my covenant that he has broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:20: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:21: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and you shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:22: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:
live.canon|ezekiel|17:1: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|17:2: Son of Adam, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel);
live.canon|ezekiel|17:4: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:5: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:6: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:7: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:8: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:11: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|17:14: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:17: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:
live.canon|ezekiel|17:12: Say now to the rebellious house, Know you not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and has taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;
live.canon|ezekiel|17:13: And has taken of the king’s seed, and made a covenant with him, and has taken an oath of him: he has also taken the mighty of the land:
live.canon|ezekiel|17:15: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that does such things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?
live.canon|ezekiel|17:16: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), surely in the place where the king dwells that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:23: In the mountain of the height of Yashar'el (Israel) will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:24: And all the trees of the field shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken and have done it.
live.canon|ezekiel|17:18: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and has done all these things, he shall not escape.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:2: What mean you, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge?
live.canon|ezekiel|18:3: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), you shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|ezekiel|18:4: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sins, it shall die.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:6: And has not eaten upon the mountains, neither has lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), neither has defiled his neighbour’s wife, neither has come near to a menstruous woman,
live.canon|ezekiel|18:7: And has not oppressed any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has spoiled none by violence, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;
live.canon|ezekiel|18:8: He that has not given forth upon usury, neither has taken any increase, that has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true judgment between man and man,
live.canon|ezekiel|18:9: Has walked in my statutes, and has kept my judgments, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|18:10: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that does the like to any one of these things,
live.canon|ezekiel|18:11: And that does not any of those duties, but even has eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour’s wife,
live.canon|ezekiel|18:12: Has oppressed the poor and needy, has spoiled by violence, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,
live.canon|ezekiel|18:13: Has given forth upon usury, and has taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he has done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:14: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and considereth, and does not such like,
live.canon|ezekiel|18:15: That has not eaten upon the mountains, neither has lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), has not defiled his neighbour’s wife,
live.canon|ezekiel|18:16: Neither has oppressed any, has not withholden the pledge, neither has spoiled by violence, but has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment,
live.canon|ezekiel|18:17: That has taken off his hand from the poor, that has not received usury nor increase, has executed my judgments, has walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:19: Yet say you, Why? does not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he shall surely live.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:21: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he has committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:22: All his transgressions that he has committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he has done he shall live.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:23: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): and not that he should return from his ways, and live?
live.canon|ezekiel|18:24: But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, shall he live? All his righteousness that he has done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them shall he die.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:26: When a righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in them; for his iniquity that he has done shall he die.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:27: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:28: Because he considereth, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:30: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), every one according to his ways, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD). Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:31: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby you have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will you die, O house of Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.canon|ezekiel|18:32: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dies, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): wherefore turn yourselves, and live you.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:1: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me again, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|18:5: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
live.canon|ezekiel|18:18: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:20: The soul that sins, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
live.canon|ezekiel|18:25: Yet you say, The way of Adonai (Lord) is not equal. Hear now, O house of Yashar'el (Israel); Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?
live.canon|ezekiel|18:29: Yet says the house of Yashar'el (Israel), The way of Adonai (Lord) is not equal. O house of Yashar'el (Israel), are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
live.canon|ezekiel|19:1: Moreover take you up a lamentation for the princes of Yashar'el (Israel),
live.canon|ezekiel|19:2: And say, What is your mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.
live.canon|ezekiel|19:10: Your mother is like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
live.canon|ezekiel|19:14: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which has devoured her fruit, so that she has no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.
live.canon|ezekiel|19:3: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.
live.canon|ezekiel|19:4: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.
live.canon|ezekiel|19:5: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
live.canon|ezekiel|19:6: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.
live.canon|ezekiel|19:7: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.
live.canon|ezekiel|19:8: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.
live.canon|ezekiel|19:9: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|ezekiel|19:11: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.
live.canon|ezekiel|19:12: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.
live.canon|ezekiel|19:13: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:3: Son of Adam, speak unto the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Are you come to enquire of me? As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), I will not be enquired of by you.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:4: Will you judge them, son of Adam, will you judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:
live.canon|ezekiel|20:5: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); In the day when I chose Yashar'el (Israel), and lifted up my hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up my hand unto them, saying, I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God);
live.canon|ezekiel|20:6: In the day that I lifted up my hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:
live.canon|ezekiel|20:7: Then said I unto them, Cast you away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|ezekiel|20:26: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that opens the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|20:27: Therefore, son of Adam, speak unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:28: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up my hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:29: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto you go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:30: Wherefore say unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Are you polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit you whoredom after their abominations?
live.canon|ezekiel|20:31: For when you offer your gifts, when you make your sons to pass through the fire, you pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Yashar'el (Israel)? As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), I will not be enquired of by you.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:32: And that which comes into your mind shall not be at all, that you say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:33: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
live.canon|ezekiel|20:34: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein you are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:36: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|20:38: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Yashar'el (Israel): and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|20:39: As for you, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Go you, serve you every one his idols, and hereafter also, if you will not hearken unto me: but pollute you my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:40: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Yashar'el (Israel), says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), there shall all the house of Yashar'el (Israel), all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:41: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein you have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:47: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD); Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it shall devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:1: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel) came to enquire of Yahuah (LORD), and sat before me.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:2: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|20:8: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:9: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:10: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:11: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:12: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Yahuah (LORD) that sanctify them.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:13: But the house of Yashar'el (Israel) rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:14: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:15: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;
live.canon|ezekiel|20:17: Nevertheless my eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:18: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk you not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:
live.canon|ezekiel|20:16: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:19: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God); walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;
live.canon|ezekiel|20:21: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:24: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:25: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;
live.canon|ezekiel|20:35: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:37: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:
live.canon|ezekiel|20:20: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|ezekiel|20:22: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand, and wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:23: I lifted up my hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;
live.canon|ezekiel|20:45: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|20:42: And you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I shall bring you into the land of Yashar'el (Israel), into the country for the which I lifted up my hand to give it to your fathers.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:43: And there shall you remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein you have been defiled; and you shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have committed.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:44: And you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I have wrought with you for my name’s sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O you house of Yashar'el (Israel), says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|20:48: And all flesh shall see that I Yahuah (LORD) have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
live.canon|ezekiel|20:46: Son of Adam, set your face toward the south, and drop your word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;
live.canon|ezekiel|20:49: Then said I, Ah Adonai (Lord) GOD! they say of me, Does he not speak parables?
live.canon|ezekiel|21:2: Son of Adam, set your face toward Jerusalem, and drop your word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Yashar'el (Israel),
live.canon|ezekiel|21:3: And say to the land of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I am against you, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:4: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
live.canon|ezekiel|21:6: Sigh therefore, you son of Adam, with the breaking of your loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:7: And it shall be, when they say unto you, Wherefore sighest you? that you shall answer, For the tidings; because it comes: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it comes, and shall be brought to pass, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|21:9: Son of Adam, prophesy, and say, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:
live.canon|ezekiel|21:11: And he has given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:12: Cry and howl, son of Adam: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Yashar'el (Israel): terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon your thigh.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:13: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|21:14: You therefore, son of Adam, prophesy, and smite your hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which enters into their privy chambers.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:16: Go you one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever your face is set.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:17: I will also smite my hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I Yahuah (LORD) have said it.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:19: Also, you son of Adam, appoint you two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose you a place, choose it at the head of the way to the city.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:24: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say, that you are come to remembrance, you shall be taken with the hand.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:25: And you, profane wicked prince of Yashar'el (Israel), whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,
live.canon|ezekiel|21:26: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:31: And I will pour out my indignation upon you, I will blow against you in the fire of my wrath, and deliver you into the hand of brutish men, and skilful to destroy.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:32: You shall be for fuel to the fire; your blood shall be in the midst of the land; you shall be no more remembered: for I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:1: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|21:5: That all flesh may know that I Yahuah (LORD) have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:8: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|21:10: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:15: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:18: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me again, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|21:20: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Yahudah (Judah) in Jerusalem the defenced.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:21: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:22: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:23: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:27: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:28: And you, son of Adam, prophesy and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say you, The sword, the sword is drawn: for the slaughter it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:
live.canon|ezekiel|21:29: Whiles they see vanity unto you, whiles they divine a lie unto you, to bring you upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.
live.canon|ezekiel|21:30: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge you in the place where you were created, in the land of your nativity.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:2: Now, you son of Adam, will you judge, will you judge the bloody city? yea, you shall shew her all her abominations.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:3: Then say you, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and makes idols against herself to defile herself.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:4: You are become guilty in your blood that you have shed; and have defiled thyself in your idols which you have made; and you have caused your days to draw near, and are come even unto your years: therefore have I made you a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:5: Those that be near, and those that be far from you, shall mock you, which are infamous and much vexed.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:6: Behold, the princes of Yashar'el (Israel), every one were in you to their power to shed blood.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:7: In you have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of you have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in you have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:8: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my sabbaths.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:9: In you are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in you they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of you they commit lewdness.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:10: In you have they discovered their fathers’ nakedness: in you have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.
