live.canon|ezekiel|22:11: And one has committed abomination with his neighbour’s wife; and another has lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:12: In you have they taken gifts to shed blood; you have taken usury and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbours by extortion, and have forgotten me, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|22:13: Behold, therefore I have smitten my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at your blood which has been in the midst of you.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:14: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with you? I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it, and will do it.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:15: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and disperse you in the countries, and will consume your filthiness out of you.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:16: And you shall take your inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|22:19: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:20: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in my anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:21: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and you shall be melted in the midst thereof.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:22: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall you be melted in the midst thereof; and you shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) have poured out my fury upon you.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:24: Son of Adam, say unto her, You are the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:26: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned my holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:28: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), when Yahuah (LORD) has not spoken.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:31: Therefore have I poured out my indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|22:1: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|22:17: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|22:18: Son of Adam, the house of Yashar'el (Israel) is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:23: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|22:25: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:27: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:29: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.
live.canon|ezekiel|22:30: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:26: They shall also strip you out of your clothes, and take away your fair jewels.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:27: Thus will I make your lewdness to cease from you, and your whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that you shall not lift up your eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:28: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of them whom you hate, into the hand of them from whom your mind is alienated:
live.canon|ezekiel|23:29: And they shall deal with you hatefully, and shall take away all your labour, and shall leave you naked and bare: and the nakedness of your whoredoms shall be discovered, both your lewdness and your whoredoms.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:30: I will do these things unto you, because you have gone a whoring after the heathen, and because you are polluted with their idols.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:31: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore will I give her cup into your hand.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:32: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); You shall drink of your sister’s cup deep and large: you shall be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:33: You shall be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of your sister Samaria.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:34: You shall even drink it and suck it out, and you shall break the sherds thereof, and pluck off your own breasts: for I have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|23:35: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you have forgotten me, and cast me behind your back, therefore bear you also your lewdness and your whoredoms.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:36: Yahuah (LORD) said moreover unto me; Son of Adam, will you judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;
live.canon|ezekiel|23:39: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of my house.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:40: And furthermore, that you have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom you did wash thyself, paintedst your eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,
live.canon|ezekiel|23:41: And sat upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon you have set my incense and my oil.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:46: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:49: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and you shall bear the sins of your idols: and you shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|23:1: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|23:2: Son of Adam, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
live.canon|ezekiel|23:3: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:4: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:5: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,
live.canon|ezekiel|23:21: Thus you called to remembrance the lewdness of your youth, in bruising your teats by the Egyptians for the paps of your youth.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:22: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will raise up your lovers against you, from whom your mind is alienated, and I will bring them against you on every side;
live.canon|ezekiel|23:24: And they shall come against you with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against you buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge you according to their judgments.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:25: And I will set my jealousy against you, and they shall deal furiously with you: they shall take away your nose and your ears; and your remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take your sons and your daughters; and your residue shall be devoured by the fire.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:6: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:7: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:8: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:9: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:10: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:11: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:12: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:13: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,
live.canon|ezekiel|23:14: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
live.canon|ezekiel|23:15: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:
live.canon|ezekiel|23:16: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:17: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:18: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:19: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:20: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:23: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:37: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:38: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:42: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:43: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them?
live.canon|ezekiel|23:44: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:45: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:47: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
live.canon|ezekiel|23:48: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:2: Son of Adam, write you the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:3: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Set on a pot, set it on, and also pour water into it:
live.canon|ezekiel|24:6: Wherefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:9: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:12: She has wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:13: In your filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged you, and you were not purged, you shall not be purged from your filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon you.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:14: I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to your ways, and according to your doings, shall they judge you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|24:16: Son of Adam, behold, I take away from you the desire of your eyes with a stroke: yet neither shall you mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:17: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of your head upon you, and put on your shoes upon your feet, and cover not your lips, and eat not the bread of men.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:19: And the people said unto me, Will you not tell us what these things are to us, that you do so?
live.canon|ezekiel|24:21: Speak unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left shall fall by the sword.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:22: And you shall do as I have done: you shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:23: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: you shall not mourn nor weep; but you shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:24: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he has done shall you do: and when this comes, you shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|24:25: Also, you son of Adam, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,
live.canon|ezekiel|24:26: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?
live.canon|ezekiel|24:27: In that day shall your mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and you shall speak, and be no more dumb: and you shall be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|24:1: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|24:4: Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:5: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:7: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;
live.canon|ezekiel|24:8: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:10: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:11: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:15: Also the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|24:18: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
live.canon|ezekiel|24:20: Then I answered them, The word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|25:2: Son of Adam, set your face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;
live.canon|ezekiel|25:3: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Yashar'el (Israel), when it was desolate; and against the house of Yahudah (Judah), when they went into captivity;
live.canon|ezekiel|25:4: Behold, therefore I will deliver you to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in you, and make their dwellings in you: they shall eat your fruit, and they shall drink your milk.
live.canon|ezekiel|25:5: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|25:6: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you have clapped your hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all your despite against the land of Yashar'el (Israel);
live.canon|ezekiel|25:7: Behold, therefore I will stretch out my hand upon you, and will deliver you for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut you off from the people, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries: I will destroy you; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|25:8: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Yahudah (Judah) is like unto all the heathen;
live.canon|ezekiel|25:12: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because that Edom has dealt against the house of Yahudah (Judah) by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
live.canon|ezekiel|25:13: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will also stretch out my hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.
live.canon|ezekiel|25:14: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Yashar'el (Israel): and they shall do in Edom according to my anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|25:15: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;
live.canon|ezekiel|25:16: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will stretch out my hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
live.canon|ezekiel|25:1: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|25:9: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,
live.canon|ezekiel|25:10: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.
live.canon|ezekiel|25:11: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|25:17: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
live.canon|ezekiel|26:2: Son of Adam, because that Tyrus has said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:
live.canon|ezekiel|26:3: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against you, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes his waves to come up.
live.canon|ezekiel|26:5: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): and it shall become a spoil to the nations.
live.canon|ezekiel|26:7: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.
live.canon|ezekiel|26:8: He shall slay with the sword your daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against you, and cast a mount against you, and lift up the buckler against you.
live.canon|ezekiel|26:9: And he shall set engines of war against your walls, and with his axes he shall break down your towers.
live.canon|ezekiel|26:10: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover you: your walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into your gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
live.canon|ezekiel|26:11: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all your streets: he shall slay your people by the sword, and your strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.
live.canon|ezekiel|26:12: And they shall make a spoil of your riches, and make a prey of your merchandise: and they shall break down your walls, and destroy your pleasant houses: and they shall lay your stones and your timber and your dust in the midst of the water.
live.canon|ezekiel|26:13: And I will cause the noise of your songs to cease; and the sound of your harps shall be no more heard.
live.canon|ezekiel|26:14: And I will make you like the top of a rock: you shall be a place to spread nets upon; you shall be built no more: for I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|26:15: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of you?
live.canon|ezekiel|26:16: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at you.
live.canon|ezekiel|26:17: And they shall take up a lamentation for you, and say to you, How are you destroyed, that were inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which were strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!
live.canon|ezekiel|26:18: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of your fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at your departure.
live.canon|ezekiel|26:19: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); When I shall make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon you, and great waters shall cover you;
live.canon|ezekiel|26:20: When I shall bring you down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set you in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;
live.canon|ezekiel|26:21: I will make you a terror, and you shall be no more: though you be sought for, yet shall you never be found again, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|26:1: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|26:4: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
live.canon|ezekiel|26:6: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|27:23: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were your merchants.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:2: Now, you son of Adam, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;
live.canon|ezekiel|27:3: And say unto Tyrus, O you that are situate at the entry of the sea, which are a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); O Tyrus, you have said, I am of perfect beauty.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:4: Your borders are in the midst of the seas, your builders have perfected your beauty.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:5: They have made all your ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for you.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:6: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made your oars; the company of the Ashurites have made your benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:7: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which you spreadest forth to be your sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered you.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:8: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were your mariners: your wise men, O Tyrus, that were in you, were your pilots.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:9: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in you your calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to occupy your merchandise.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:10: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in your army, your men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in you; they set forth your comeliness.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:11: The men of Arvad with your army were upon your walls round about, and the Gammadims were in your towers: they hanged their shields upon your walls round about; they have made your beauty perfect.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:12: Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in your fairs.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:13: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were your merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in your market.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:14: They of the house of Togarmah traded in your fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:15: The men of Dedan were your merchants; many isles were the merchandise of your hand: they brought you for a present horns of ivory and ebony.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:16: Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of your making: they occupied in your fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:17: Yahudah (Judah), and the land of Yashar'el (Israel), they were your merchants: they traded in your market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:18: Damascus was your merchant in the multitude of the wares of your making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:19: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in your fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in your market.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:20: Dedan was your merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:21: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with you in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they your merchants.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:22: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were your merchants: they occupied in your fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:24: These were your merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among your merchandise.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:25: The ships of Tarshish did sing of you in your market: and you were replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:26: Your rowers have brought you into great waters: the east wind has broken you in the midst of the seas.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:27: Your riches, and your fairs, your merchandise, your mariners, and your pilots, your calkers, and the occupiers of your merchandise, and all your men of war, that are in you, and in all your company which is in the midst of you, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of your ruin.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:30: And shall cause their voice to be heard against you, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
live.canon|ezekiel|27:31: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for you, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for you with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:32: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for you, and lament over you, saying, What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?
live.canon|ezekiel|27:33: When your wares went forth out of the seas, you filledst many people; you did enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of your riches and of your merchandise.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:34: In the time when you shall be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters your merchandise and all your company in the midst of you shall fall.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:35: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at you, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:36: The merchants among the people shall hiss at you; you shall be a terror, and never shall be any more.
live.canon|ezekiel|27:1: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|27:29: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
live.canon|ezekiel|27:28: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of your pilots.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:2: Son of Adam, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, I am a Elohim (God), I sit in the seat of Elohim (God), in the midst of the seas; yet you are a man, and not Elohim (God), though you set your heart as the heart of Elohim (God):
live.canon|ezekiel|28:3: Behold, you are wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from you:
live.canon|ezekiel|28:4: With your wisdom and with your understanding you have gotten you riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasures:
live.canon|ezekiel|28:5: By your great wisdom and by your traffick have you increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches:
live.canon|ezekiel|28:6: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you have set your heart as the heart of Elohim (God);
live.canon|ezekiel|28:7: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon you, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom, and they shall defile your brightness.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:8: They shall bring you down to the pit, and you shall die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:9: Will you yet say before him that slayeth you, I am Elohim (God)? but you shall be a man, and no Elohim (God), in the hand of him that slayeth you.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:10: You shall die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|28:12: Son of Adam, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); You sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:13: You have been in Eden the garden of Elohim (God); every precious stone was your covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of your tabrets and of your pipes was prepared in you in the day that you were created.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:14: You are the anointed cherub that covers; and I have set you so: you were upon the holy mountain of Elohim (God); you have walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:15: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, till iniquity was found in you.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:16: By the multitude of your merchandise they have filled the midst of you with violence, and you have sinned: therefore I will cast you as profane out of the mountain of Elohim (God): and I will destroy you, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:17: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty, you have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your brightness: I will cast you to the ground, I will lay you before kings, that they may behold you.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:18: You have defiled your sanctuaries by the multitude of your iniquities, by the iniquity of your traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of you, it shall devour you, and I will bring you to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold you.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:19: All they that know you among the people shall be astonished at you: you shall be a terror, and never shall you be any more.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:21: Son of Adam, set your face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,
live.canon|ezekiel|28:22: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against you, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of you: and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:25: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); When I shall have gathered the house of Yashar'el (Israel) from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.
live.canon|ezekiel|28:1: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|28:11: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|28:20: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|28:23: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|28:24: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|28:26: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God).
live.canon|ezekiel|29:3: Speak, and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lies in the midst of his rivers, which has said, My river is my own, and I have made it for myself.
live.canon|ezekiel|29:4: But I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will cause the fish of your rivers to stick unto your scales, and I will bring you up out of the midst of your rivers, and all the fish of your rivers shall stick unto your scales.
live.canon|ezekiel|29:5: And I will leave you thrown into the wilderness, you and all the fish of your rivers: you shall fall upon the open fields; you shall not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given you for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.
live.canon|ezekiel|29:7: When they took hold of you by your hand, you did break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon you, you brakest, and made all their loins to be at a stand.
live.canon|ezekiel|29:9: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD): because he has said, The river is mine, and I have made it.
live.canon|ezekiel|29:10: Behold, therefore I am against you, and against your rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.
live.canon|ezekiel|29:13: Yet thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:
live.canon|ezekiel|29:16: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), which brings their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|29:19: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.
live.canon|ezekiel|29:20: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|29:21: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) to bud forth, and I will give you the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|29:1: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|29:2: Son of Adam, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:
live.canon|ezekiel|29:8: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will bring a sword upon you, and cut off man and beast out of you.
live.canon|ezekiel|29:6: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|ezekiel|29:11: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.
live.canon|ezekiel|29:12: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
live.canon|ezekiel|29:14: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
live.canon|ezekiel|29:15: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.
live.canon|ezekiel|29:17: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|29:18: Son of Adam, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:
live.canon|ezekiel|30:2: Son of Adam, prophesy and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Howl you, Woe worth the day!
live.canon|ezekiel|30:6: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|30:9: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it comes.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:10: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:13: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:22: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:1: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|30:3: For the day is near, even the day of Yahuah (LORD) is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:4: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:5: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:7: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:8: And they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:11: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:12: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:14: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:15: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:16: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph shall have distresses daily.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:17: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword: and these cities shall go into captivity.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:18: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:19: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|30:20: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|30:21: Son of Adam, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:23: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:24: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh’s arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:25: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.
live.canon|ezekiel|30:26: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|31:2: Son of Adam, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom are you like in your greatness?
live.canon|ezekiel|31:10: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you have lifted up thyself in height, and he has shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;
live.canon|ezekiel|31:15: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
live.canon|ezekiel|31:18: To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shall you be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: you shall lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|31:1: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|31:3: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.
live.canon|ezekiel|31:4: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.
live.canon|ezekiel|31:5: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.
live.canon|ezekiel|31:6: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.
live.canon|ezekiel|31:7: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.
live.canon|ezekiel|31:8: The cedars in the garden of Elohim (God) could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chesnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of Elohim (God) was like unto him in his beauty.
live.canon|ezekiel|31:9: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of Elohim (God), envied him.
live.canon|ezekiel|31:11: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.
live.canon|ezekiel|31:12: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.
live.canon|ezekiel|31:13: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:
live.canon|ezekiel|31:14: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.
live.canon|ezekiel|31:16: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.
live.canon|ezekiel|31:17: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword; and they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:3: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will therefore spread out my net over you with a company of many people; and they shall bring you up in my net.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:4: Then will I leave you upon the land, I will cast you forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon you, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with you.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:6: I will also water with your blood the land wherein you swimmest, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of you.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:7: And when I shall put you out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:8: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over you, and set darkness upon your land, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|32:9: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring your destruction among the nations, into the countries which you have not known.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:10: Yea, I will make many people amazed at you, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for you, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of your fall.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:11: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon you.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:12: By the swords of the mighty will I cause your multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:14: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|32:16: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, even for Egypt, and for all her multitude, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|32:19: Whom do you pass in beauty? go down, and be you laid with the uncircumcised.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:28: Yea, you shall be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shall lie with them that are slain with the sword.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:31: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|32:32: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|32:1: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|32:2: Son of Adam, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, You are like a young lion of the nations, and you are as a whale in the seas: and you came forth with your rivers, and troubledst the waters with your feet, and fouledst their rivers.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:13: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:15: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|32:17: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|32:18: Son of Adam, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:20: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:21: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:22: Asshur is there and all her company: his graves are about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:
live.canon|ezekiel|32:23: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:24: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:25: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that be slain.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:26: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:27: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:29: There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:30: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.
live.canon|ezekiel|32:5: And I will lay your flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:5: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that takes warning shall deliver his soul.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:7: So you, O son of Adam, I have set you a watchman unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel); therefore you shall hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:8: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, you shall surely die; if you do not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at your hand.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:9: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:10: Therefore, O you son of Adam, speak unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel); Thus you speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?
live.canon|ezekiel|33:11: Say unto them, As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn you, turn you from your evil ways; for why will you die, O house of Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.canon|ezekiel|33:12: Therefore, you son of Adam, say unto the children of your people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sins.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:13: When I shall say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he has committed, he shall die for it.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:14: Again, when I say unto the wicked, You shall surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;
live.canon|ezekiel|33:16: None of his sins that he has committed shall be mentioned unto him: he has done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:18: When the righteous turns from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, he shall even die thereby.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:25: Wherefore say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall you possess the land?
live.canon|ezekiel|33:26: You stand upon your sword, you work abomination, and you defile every one his neighbour’s wife: and shall you possess the land?
live.canon|ezekiel|33:27: Say you thus unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); As I live, surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:17: Yet the children of your people say, The way of Adonai (Lord) is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:30: Also, you son of Adam, the children of your people still are talking against you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that comes forth from Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|33:31: And they come unto you as the people comes, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goes after their covetousness.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:32: And, lo, you are unto them as a very lovely song of one that has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear your words, but they do them not.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:33: And when this comes to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet has been among them.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:1: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|33:6: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:2: Son of Adam, speak to the children of your people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:
live.canon|ezekiel|33:3: If when he sees the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;
live.canon|ezekiel|33:15: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:19: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:21: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:22: Now the hand of Yahuah (LORD) was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:23: Then the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|33:24: Son of Adam, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Yashar'el (Israel) speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:28: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:29: Then shall they know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:4: Then whosoever hears the sound of the trumpet, and takes not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.
live.canon|ezekiel|33:20: Yet you say, The way of Adonai (Lord) is not equal. O you house of Yashar'el (Israel), I will judge you every one after his ways.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:2: Son of Adam, prophesy against the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel), prophesy, and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel) that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?
live.canon|ezekiel|34:3: You eat the fat, and you clothe you with the wool, you kill them that are fed: but you feed not the flock.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:4: The diseased have you not strengthened, neither have you healed that which was sick, neither have you bound up that which was broken, neither have you brought again that which was driven away, neither have you sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have you ruled them.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:7: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of Yahuah (LORD);
live.canon|ezekiel|34:8: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;
live.canon|ezekiel|34:9: Therefore, O you shepherds, hear the word of Yahuah (LORD);
live.canon|ezekiel|34:10: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:11: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:12: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:15: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|34:17: And as for you, O my flock, thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:18: Seems it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but you must foul the residue with your feet?
live.canon|ezekiel|34:19: And as for my flock, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:21: Because you have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till you have scattered them abroad;
live.canon|ezekiel|34:30: Thus shall they know that I Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God) am with them, and that they, even the house of Yashar'el (Israel), are my people, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|34:31: And you my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your Elohim (God), says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|34:1: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|34:5: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:6: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek after them.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:20: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) unto them; Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:13: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel) by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:14: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Yashar'el (Israel) shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|ezekiel|34:16: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:22: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:23: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:24: And I Yahuah (LORD) will be their Elohim (God), and my servant David a prince among them; I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:25: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:26: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:27: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:28: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.
live.canon|ezekiel|34:29: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.
live.canon|ezekiel|35:2: Son of Adam, set your face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
live.canon|ezekiel|35:3: And say unto it, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, O mount Seir, I am against you, and I will stretch out my hand against you, and I will make you most desolate.
live.canon|ezekiel|35:4: I will lay your cities waste, and you shall be desolate, and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|35:5: Because you have had a perpetual hatred, and have shed the blood of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end:
live.canon|ezekiel|35:6: Therefore, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), I will prepare you unto blood, and blood shall pursue you: sith you have not hated blood, even blood shall pursue you.
live.canon|ezekiel|35:7: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passes out and him that returns.
live.canon|ezekiel|35:8: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in your hills, and in your valleys, and in all your rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
live.canon|ezekiel|35:9: I will make you perpetual desolations, and your cities shall not return: and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|35:10: Because you have said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas Yahuah (LORD) was there:
live.canon|ezekiel|35:11: Therefore, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), I will even do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have used out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged you.
live.canon|ezekiel|35:12: And you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), and that I have heard all your blasphemies which you have spoken against the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.
live.canon|ezekiel|35:13: Thus with your mouth you have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.
live.canon|ezekiel|35:14: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
live.canon|ezekiel|35:15: As you did rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), because it was desolate, so will I do unto you: you shall be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|35:1: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|36:1: Also, you son of Adam, prophesy unto the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), and say, You mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), hear the word of Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|ezekiel|36:2: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because the enemy has said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:
live.canon|ezekiel|36:3: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:
live.canon|ezekiel|36:4: Therefore, you mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), hear the word of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;
live.canon|ezekiel|36:5: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:6: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because you have borne the shame of the heathen:
live.canon|ezekiel|36:7: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I have lifted up my hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:8: But you, O mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), you shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Yashar'el (Israel); for they are at hand to come.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:9: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and you shall be tilled and sown:
live.canon|ezekiel|36:11: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|36:12: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Yashar'el (Israel); and they shall possess you, and you shall be their inheritance, and you shall no more henceforth bereave them of men.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:13: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because they say unto you, You land devourest up men, and have bereaved your nations;
live.canon|ezekiel|36:14: Therefore you shall devour men no more, neither bereave your nations any more, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|36:15: Neither will I cause men to hear in you the shame of the heathen any more, neither shall you bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shall you cause your nations to fall any more, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|ezekiel|36:21: But I had pity for my holy name, which the house of Yashar'el (Israel) had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:22: Therefore say unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I do not this for your sakes, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), but for my holy name’s sake, which you have profaned among the heathen, whither you went.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:23: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which you have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:25: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and you shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:27: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and you shall keep my judgments, and do them.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:28: And you shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and you shall be my people, and I will be your Elohim (God).
live.canon|ezekiel|36:30: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that you shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:31: Then shall you remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:32: Not for your sakes do I this, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|ezekiel|36:33: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:37: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Yashar'el (Israel), to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:10: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Yashar'el (Israel), even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:
live.canon|ezekiel|36:16: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|ezekiel|36:17: Son of Adam, when the house of Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:18: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:
live.canon|ezekiel|36:19: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:20: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of Yahuah (LORD), and are gone forth out of his land.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:24: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:26: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:29: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:34: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:35: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:36: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it, and I will do it.
live.canon|ezekiel|36:38: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|37:4: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O you dry bones, hear the word of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|37:5: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you shall live:
live.canon|ezekiel|37:6: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you shall live; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|37:9: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of Adam, and say to the wind, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.
live.canon|ezekiel|37:12: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|ezekiel|37:13: And you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,
live.canon|ezekiel|37:14: And shall put my spirit in you, and you shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall you know that I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it, and performed it, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|ezekiel|37:16: Moreover, you son of Adam, take you one stick, and write upon it, For Yahudah (Judah), and for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) his companions:
live.canon|ezekiel|37:17: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in your hand.
live.canon|ezekiel|37:18: And when the children of your people shall speak unto you, saying, Will you not shew us what you meanest by these?
