live.canon|luke|6:10: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth your hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
live.canon|luke|6:20: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be you poor: for yours is the kingdom of Elohim (God).
live.canon|luke|6:22: Blessed are you, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of Adam’s sake.
live.canon|luke|6:23: Rejoice you in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
live.canon|luke|6:25: Woe unto you that are full! for you shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for you shall mourn and weep.
live.canon|luke|6:29: And unto him that smites you on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that takes away your cloke forbid not to take your coat also.
live.canon|luke|6:30: Give to every man that asks of you; and of him that takes away your goods ask them not again.
live.canon|luke|6:31: And as you would that men should do to you, do you also to them likewise.
live.canon|luke|6:32: For if you love them which love you, what thank have you? for sinners also love those that love them.
live.canon|luke|6:33: And if you do good to them which do good to you, what thank have you? for sinners also do even the same.
live.canon|luke|6:34: And if you lend to them of whom you hope to receive, what thank have you? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
live.canon|luke|6:35: But love you your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and you shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
live.canon|luke|6:36: Be you therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
live.canon|luke|6:37: Judge not, and you shall not be judged: condemn not, and you shall not be condemned: forgive, and you shall be forgiven:
live.canon|luke|6:38: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that you mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
live.canon|luke|6:41: And why behold you the mote that is in your brother’s eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in your own eye?
live.canon|luke|6:42: Either how can you say to your brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in your eye, when you thyself behold not the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of your own eye, and then shall you see clearly to pull out the mote that is in your brother’s eye.
live.canon|luke|6:43: For a good tree brings not forth corrupt fruit; neither does a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
live.canon|luke|6:45: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks.
live.canon|luke|6:47: Whosoever comes to me, and hears my sayings, and does them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
live.canon|luke|6:49: But he that hears, and does not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
live.canon|luke|6:1: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
live.canon|luke|6:4: How he went into the house of Elohim (God), and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
live.canon|luke|6:6: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
live.canon|luke|6:7: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
live.canon|luke|6:8: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
live.canon|luke|6:9: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
live.canon|luke|6:11: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|luke|6:12: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to Elohim (God).
live.canon|luke|6:13: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
live.canon|luke|6:14: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
live.canon|luke|6:15: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphæus, and Simon called Zelotes,
live.canon|luke|6:16: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
live.canon|luke|6:17: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judæa and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
live.canon|luke|6:18: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
live.canon|luke|6:19: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
live.canon|luke|6:26: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
live.canon|luke|6:21: Blessed are you that hunger now: for you shall be filled. Blessed are you that weep now: for you shall laugh.
live.canon|luke|6:24: But woe unto you that are rich! for you have received your consolation.
live.canon|luke|6:27: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
live.canon|luke|6:28: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
live.canon|luke|6:39: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
live.canon|luke|6:40: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
live.canon|luke|6:44: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
live.canon|luke|6:48: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
live.canon|luke|6:46: And why call you me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
live.canon|luke|6:5: And he said unto them, That the Son of Adam is the Lord also of the sabbath.

live.canon|luke|7:7: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto you: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
live.canon|luke|7:8: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it.
live.canon|luke|7:14: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto you, Arise.
live.canon|luke|7:20: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist has sent us unto you, saying, Are you he that should come? or look we for another?
live.canon|luke|7:22: Then Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things you have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
live.canon|luke|7:24: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went you out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
live.canon|luke|7:25: But what went you out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.
live.canon|luke|7:27: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before your face, which shall prepare your way before you.
live.canon|luke|7:32: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and you have not danced; we have mourned to you, and you have not wept.
live.canon|luke|7:33: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and you say, He has a devil.
live.canon|luke|7:34: The Son of Adam is come eating and drinking; and you say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
live.canon|luke|7:39: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that touches him: for she is a sinner.
live.canon|luke|7:40: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto you. And he says, Master, say on.
live.canon|luke|7:43: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, You have rightly judged.
live.canon|luke|7:44: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, See you this woman? I entered into your house, you gave me no water for my feet: but she has washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
live.canon|luke|7:45: You gave me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in has not ceased to kiss my feet.
live.canon|luke|7:48: And he said unto her, Your sins are forgiven.
live.canon|luke|7:1: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
live.canon|luke|7:2: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
live.canon|luke|7:3: And when he heard of Yahusha (Jesus), he sent unto him the elders of the Yahudim (Jews), beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
live.canon|luke|7:4: And when they came to Yahusha (Jesus), they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
live.canon|luke|7:9: When Yahusha (Jesus) heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|luke|7:10: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
live.canon|luke|7:11: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
live.canon|luke|7:12: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
live.canon|luke|7:15: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
live.canon|luke|7:17: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judæa, and throughout all the region round about.
live.canon|luke|7:18: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
live.canon|luke|7:50: And he said to the woman, Your faith has saved you; go in peace.
live.canon|luke|7:46: My head with oil you did not anoint: but this woman has anointed my feet with ointment.
live.canon|luke|7:47: Wherefore I say unto you, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little.
live.canon|luke|7:16: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified Elohim (God), saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That Elohim (God) has visited his people.
live.canon|luke|7:21: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
live.canon|luke|7:23: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
live.canon|luke|7:28: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of Elohim (God) is greater than he.
live.canon|luke|7:29: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified Elohim (God), being baptized with the baptism of John.
live.canon|luke|7:30: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of Elohim (God) against themselves, being not baptized of him.
live.canon|luke|7:35: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
live.canon|luke|7:36: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to meat.
live.canon|luke|7:37: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Yahusha (Jesus) sat at meat in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

live.canon|luke|7:41: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
live.canon|luke|7:42: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
live.canon|luke|7:49: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
live.canon|luke|7:19: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Yahusha (Jesus), saying, Are you he that should come? or look we for another?
live.canon|luke|7:26: But what went you out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
live.canon|luke|7:6: Then Yahusha (Jesus) went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that you should enter under my roof:
live.canon|luke|7:13: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
live.canon|luke|7:31: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
live.canon|luke|8:30: And Yahusha (Jesus) asked him, saying, What is your name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
live.canon|luke|8:39: Return to your own house, and shew how great things Elohim (God) has done unto you. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Yahusha (Jesus) had done unto him.
live.canon|luke|8:1: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of Elohim (God): and the twelve were with him,
live.canon|luke|8:2: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
live.canon|luke|8:3: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
live.canon|luke|8:4: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
live.canon|luke|8:5: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
live.canon|luke|8:6: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
live.canon|luke|8:7: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
live.canon|luke|8:9: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
live.canon|luke|8:10: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of Elohim (God): but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
live.canon|luke|8:11: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of Elohim (God).
live.canon|luke|8:13: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
live.canon|luke|8:14: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
live.canon|luke|8:15: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
live.canon|luke|8:8: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that has ears to hear, let him hear.
live.canon|luke|8:12: Those by the way side are they that hear; then comes the devil, and takes away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
live.canon|luke|8:16: No man, when he has lighted a candle, covers it with a vessel, or puts it under a bed; but sets it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
live.canon|luke|8:18: Take heed therefore how you hear: for whosoever has, to him shall be given; and whosoever has not, from him shall be taken even that which he seems to have.
live.canon|luke|8:20: And it was told him by certain which said, Your mother and your brethren stand without, desiring to see you.
live.canon|luke|8:25: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commands even the winds and water, and they obey him.
live.canon|luke|8:28: When he saw Yahusha (Jesus), he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with you, Yahusha (Jesus), you Son of Elohim (God) most high? I beseech you, torment me not.
live.canon|luke|8:17: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
live.canon|luke|8:19: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
live.canon|luke|8:21: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of Elohim (God), and do it.
live.canon|luke|8:22: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
live.canon|luke|8:23: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.

live.canon|mark|4:10: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
live.canon|mark|4:11: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of Elohim (God): but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
live.canon|mark|4:12: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
live.canon|mark|4:9: And he said unto them, He that has ears to hear, let him hear.
live.canon|mark|4:13: And he said unto them, Know you not this parable? and how then will you know all parables?
live.canon|mark|4:16: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
live.canon|mark|4:18: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
live.canon|mark|4:20: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
live.canon|mark|4:21: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
live.canon|mark|4:22: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
live.canon|mark|4:23: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
live.canon|mark|4:26: And he said, So is the kingdom of Elohim (God), as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
live.canon|mark|4:30: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of Elohim (God)? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
live.canon|mark|4:31: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
live.canon|mark|4:33: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.
live.canon|mark|4:34: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
live.canon|mark|4:36: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
live.canon|mark|4:37: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
live.canon|mark|4:39: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
live.canon|mark|4:41: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
live.canon|mark|4:15: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan comes immediately, and takes away the word that was sown in their hearts.
live.canon|mark|4:17: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution arises for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended.
live.canon|mark|5:7: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with you, Yahusha (Jesus), you Son of the El Elyon (most high God)? I adjure you by Elohim (God), that you torment me not.
live.canon|mark|5:8: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, you unclean spirit.
live.canon|mark|5:9: And he asked him, What is your name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
live.canon|mark|5:22: And, behold, there comes one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
live.canon|mark|5:23: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lies at the point of death: I pray you, come and lay your hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
live.canon|mark|5:31: And his disciples said unto him, You see the multitude thronging you, and say you, Who touched me?
live.canon|mark|5:34: And he said unto her, Daughter, your faith has made you whole; go in peace, and be whole of your plague.
live.canon|mark|5:35: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house certain which said, Your daughter is dead: why troublest you the Master any further?
live.canon|mark|5:36: As soon as Yahusha (Jesus) heard the word that was spoken, he says unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
live.canon|mark|5:38: And he comes to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and sees the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
live.canon|mark|5:39: And when he was come in, he says unto them, Why make you this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleeps.
live.canon|mark|5:40: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he takes the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and enters in where the damsel was lying.
live.canon|mark|5:41: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto you, arise.
live.canon|mark|5:1: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
live.canon|mark|5:2: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
live.canon|mark|5:3: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
live.canon|mark|5:4: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
live.canon|mark|5:5: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
live.canon|mark|5:6: But when he saw Yahusha (Jesus) afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
live.canon|mark|5:10: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
live.canon|mark|5:11: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
live.canon|mark|5:12: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
live.canon|mark|5:13: And forthwith Yahusha (Jesus) gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
live.canon|mark|5:14: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
live.canon|mark|5:15: And they come to Yahusha (Jesus), and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
live.canon|mark|5:16: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
live.canon|mark|5:17: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
live.canon|mark|5:18: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
live.canon|mark|5:20: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Yahusha (Jesus) had done for him: and all men did marvel.
live.canon|mark|5:21: And when Yahusha (Jesus) was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
live.canon|mark|5:24: And Yahusha (Jesus) went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
live.canon|mark|5:25: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
live.canon|mark|5:26: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
live.canon|mark|5:27: When she had heard of Yahusha (Jesus), came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
live.canon|mark|5:28: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
live.canon|mark|5:29: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
live.canon|mark|5:30: And Yahusha (Jesus), immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
live.canon|mark|5:32: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
live.canon|mark|5:33: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
live.canon|mark|5:37: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
live.canon|mark|5:42: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
live.canon|mark|5:43: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
live.canon|mark|5:19: Howbeit Yahusha (Jesus) suffered him not, but says unto him, Go home to your friends, and tell them how great things the Lord has done for you, and has had compassion on you.
live.canon|mark|6:15: Others said, That it is Elijah. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
live.canon|mark|6:11: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when you depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment, than for that city.
live.canon|mark|6:2: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence has this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
live.canon|mark|6:10: And he said unto them, In what place soever you enter into an house, there abide till you depart from that place.
live.canon|mark|6:31: And he said unto them, Come you yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
live.canon|mark|6:37: He answered and said unto them, Give you them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
live.canon|mark|6:38: He says unto them, How many loaves have you? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
live.canon|mark|6:48: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he comes unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
live.canon|mark|6:50: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and says unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
live.canon|mark|6:1: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
live.canon|mark|6:3: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
live.canon|mark|6:4: But Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
live.canon|mark|6:5: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
live.canon|mark|6:6: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
live.canon|mark|6:7: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
live.canon|mark|6:8: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
live.canon|mark|6:9: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
live.canon|mark|6:12: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
live.canon|mark|6:13: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
live.canon|mark|6:14: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
live.canon|mark|6:16: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
live.canon|mark|6:17: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife: for he had married her.
live.canon|mark|6:19: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
live.canon|mark|6:18: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.
live.canon|mark|6:22: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever you will, and I will give it you.
live.canon|mark|6:23: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever you shall ask of me, I will give it you, unto the half of my kingdom.
live.canon|mark|6:25: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that you give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
live.canon|mark|6:20: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
live.canon|mark|6:21: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
live.canon|mark|6:24: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
live.canon|mark|6:26: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath’s sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
live.canon|mark|6:27: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
live.canon|mark|6:28: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
live.canon|mark|6:29: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
live.canon|mark|6:30: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Yahusha (Jesus), and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
live.canon|mark|6:32: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
live.canon|mark|6:33: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
live.canon|mark|6:34: And Yahusha (Jesus), when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
live.canon|mark|6:35: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
live.canon|mark|6:36: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
live.canon|mark|6:39: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
live.canon|mark|6:40: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
live.canon|mark|6:41: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
live.canon|mark|6:42: And they did all eat, and were filled.
live.canon|mark|6:43: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
live.canon|mark|6:44: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
live.canon|mark|6:45: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
live.canon|mark|6:46: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
live.canon|mark|6:47: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
live.canon|mark|6:49: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
live.canon|mark|6:51: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
live.canon|mark|6:52: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
live.canon|mark|6:53: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
live.canon|mark|6:54: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
live.canon|mark|6:55: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
live.canon|mark|6:56: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
live.canon|mark|7:6: He answered and said unto them, Well has Isaiah prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
live.canon|mark|7:8: For laying aside the commandment of Elohim (God), you hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things you do.
live.canon|mark|7:9: And he said unto them, Full well you reject the commandment of Elohim (God), that you may keep your own tradition.
live.canon|mark|7:10: For Moses said, Honour your father and your mother; and, Whoso curses father or mother, let him die the death:
live.canon|mark|7:11: But you say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever you might be profited by me; he shall be free.
live.canon|mark|7:12: And you suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
live.canon|mark|7:13: Making the word of Elohim (God) of none effect through your tradition, which you have delivered: and many such like things do you.
live.canon|mark|7:18: And he says unto them, Are you so without understanding also? Do you not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without enters into the man, it cannot defile him;
live.canon|mark|7:19: Because it enters not into his heart, but into the belly, and goes out into the draught, purging all meats?
live.canon|mark|7:20: And he said, That which comes out of the man, that defiles the man.
live.canon|mark|7:29: And he said unto her, For this saying go your way; the devil is gone out of your daughter.
live.canon|mark|7:34: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and says unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
live.canon|mark|7:37: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He has done all things well: he makes both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
live.canon|mark|7:1: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
live.canon|mark|7:2: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
live.canon|mark|7:3: For the Pharisees, and all the Yahudim (Jews), except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
live.canon|mark|7:4: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
live.canon|mark|7:7: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
live.canon|mark|7:5: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not your disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
live.canon|mark|7:14: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
live.canon|mark|7:15: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
live.canon|mark|7:16: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
live.canon|mark|7:17: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
live.canon|mark|7:21: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
live.canon|mark|7:22: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
live.canon|mark|7:23: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
live.canon|mark|7:24: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
live.canon|mark|7:25: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
live.canon|mark|7:26: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
live.canon|mark|7:27: But Yahusha (Jesus) said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
live.canon|mark|7:30: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
live.canon|mark|7:31: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
live.canon|mark|7:32: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
live.canon|mark|7:33: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
live.canon|mark|7:35: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
live.canon|mark|7:36: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
live.canon|mark|7:28: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs.
live.canon|mark|8:28: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elijah; and others, One of the prophets.
live.canon|mark|8:1: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Yahusha (Jesus) called his disciples unto him, and says unto them,
live.canon|mark|8:5: And he asked them, How many loaves have you? And they said, Seven.
live.canon|mark|8:12: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and says, Why does this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
live.canon|mark|8:19: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took you up? They say unto him, Twelve.
live.canon|mark|8:20: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took you up? And they said, Seven.
live.canon|mark|8:21: And he said unto them, How is it that you do not understand?
live.canon|mark|8:22: And he comes to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
live.canon|mark|8:29: And he says unto them, But whom say you that I am? And Peter answers and says unto him, You are the Messiah (Christ).
live.canon|mark|8:33: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get you behind me, Satan: for you savourest not the things that be of Elohim (God), but the things that be of men.
live.canon|mark|8:38: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of Adam be ashamed, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
live.canon|mark|8:2: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
live.canon|mark|8:3: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
live.canon|mark|8:4: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
live.canon|mark|8:6: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.
live.canon|mark|8:7: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
live.canon|mark|8:8: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
live.canon|mark|8:9: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
live.canon|mark|8:10: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
live.canon|mark|8:11: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
live.canon|mark|8:13: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
live.canon|mark|8:14: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
live.canon|mark|8:15: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
live.canon|mark|8:16: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
live.canon|mark|8:17: And when Yahusha (Jesus) knew it, he says unto them, Why reason you, because you have no bread? perceive you not yet, neither understand? have you your heart yet hardened?
live.canon|mark|8:23: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
live.canon|mark|8:24: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
live.canon|mark|8:25: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
live.canon|mark|8:26: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
live.canon|mark|8:27: And Yahusha (Jesus) went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Cæsarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
live.canon|mark|8:30: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
live.canon|mark|8:31: And he began to teach them, that the Son of Adam must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
live.canon|mark|8:32: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
live.canon|mark|8:34: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
live.canon|mark|8:35: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s, the same shall save it.
live.canon|mark|8:36: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
live.canon|mark|8:37: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
live.canon|mark|8:18: Having eyes, see you not? and having ears, hear you not? and do you not remember?
live.canon|mark|10:1: And he arose from thence, and comes into the coasts of Judæa by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
live.canon|mark|10:9: What therefore Elohim (God) has joined together, let not man put asunder.
live.canon|mark|10:11: And he says unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, commits adultery against her.
live.canon|mark|10:12: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she commits adultery.
live.canon|mark|10:19: You know the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour your father and mother.
live.canon|mark|10:21: Then Yahusha (Jesus) beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing you lackest: go your way, sell whatsoever you have, and give to the poor, and you shall have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
live.canon|mark|10:23: And Yahusha (Jesus) looked round about, and says unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God)!
live.canon|mark|10:24: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Yahusha (Jesus) answers again, and says unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God)!
live.canon|mark|10:27: And Yahusha (Jesus) looking upon them says, With men it is impossible, but not with Elohim (God): for with Elohim (God) all things are possible.
live.canon|mark|10:28: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed you.
live.canon|mark|10:29: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that has left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel’s,
live.canon|mark|10:35: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that you should do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
live.canon|mark|10:36: And he said unto them, What would you that I should do for you?
live.canon|mark|10:37: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on your right hand, and the other on your left hand, in your glory.
live.canon|mark|10:38: But Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, You know not what you ask: can you drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
live.canon|mark|10:39: And they said unto him, We can. And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, You shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall you be baptized:
live.canon|mark|10:40: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not my to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
live.canon|mark|10:42: But Yahusha (Jesus) called them to him, and says unto them, You know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
live.canon|mark|10:47: And when he heard that it was Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Yahusha (Jesus), you Son of David, have mercy on me.
live.canon|mark|10:48: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, You Son of David, have mercy on me.
live.canon|mark|10:49: And Yahusha (Jesus) stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calls you.
live.canon|mark|10:52: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Go your way; your faith has made you whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Yahusha (Jesus) in the way.
live.canon|mark|10:51: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, What will you that I should do unto you? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
live.canon|mark|10:2: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
live.canon|mark|10:3: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
live.canon|mark|10:4: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
live.canon|mark|10:5: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
live.canon|mark|10:6: But from the beginning of the creation Elohim (God) made them male and female.
live.canon|mark|10:7: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
live.canon|mark|10:8: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
live.canon|mark|10:10: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
live.canon|mark|10:13: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
live.canon|mark|10:14: But when Yahusha (Jesus) saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of Elohim (God).
live.canon|mark|10:15: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of Elohim (God) as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
live.canon|mark|10:16: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
live.canon|mark|10:17: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
live.canon|mark|10:20: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
live.canon|mark|10:18: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Why callest you me good? there is none good but one, that is, Elohim (God).
live.canon|mark|10:22: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
live.canon|mark|10:25: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God).
live.canon|mark|10:26: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
live.canon|mark|10:30: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
live.canon|mark|10:31: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
live.canon|mark|10:32: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Yahusha (Jesus) went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
live.canon|mark|10:33: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of Adam shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
live.canon|mark|10:34: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
live.canon|mark|10:41: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
live.canon|mark|10:43: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
live.canon|mark|10:44: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
live.canon|mark|10:45: For even the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
live.canon|mark|10:46: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimæus, the son of Timæus, sat by the highway side begging.
live.canon|mark|10:50: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|mark|11:1: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sends forth two of his disciples,
live.canon|mark|11:2: And says unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as you be entered into it, you shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
live.canon|mark|11:5: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do you, loosing the colt?
live.canon|mark|11:24: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever you desire, when you pray, believe that you receive them, and you shall have them.
live.canon|mark|11:25: And when you stand praying, forgive, if you have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
live.canon|mark|11:26: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
live.canon|mark|11:28: And say unto him, By what authority do you these things? and who gave you this authority to do these things?
live.canon|mark|11:31: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did you not believe him?
live.canon|mark|11:33: And they answered and said unto Yahusha (Jesus), We cannot tell. And Yahusha (Jesus) answering says unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
live.canon|mark|11:4: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
live.canon|mark|11:6: And they said unto them even as Yahusha (Jesus) had commanded: and they let them go.
live.canon|mark|11:7: And they brought the colt to Yahusha (Jesus), and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
live.canon|mark|11:8: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
live.canon|mark|11:11: And Yahusha (Jesus) entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
live.canon|mark|11:9: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that comes in the name of Yahuah (Lord):
live.canon|mark|11:10: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that comes in the name of Yahuah (Lord): Hosanna in the highest.
live.canon|mark|11:14: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of you hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
live.canon|mark|11:17: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but you have made it a den of thieves.
live.canon|mark|11:21: And Peter calling to remembrance says unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which you cursed is withered away.
live.canon|mark|11:12: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
live.canon|mark|11:13: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.
live.canon|mark|11:15: And they come to Jerusalem: and Yahusha (Jesus) went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
live.canon|mark|11:16: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
live.canon|mark|11:18: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
live.canon|mark|11:19: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
live.canon|mark|11:20: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
live.canon|mark|11:27: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
live.canon|mark|11:29: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
live.canon|mark|11:30: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
live.canon|mark|11:32: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
live.canon|mark|11:22: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering says unto them, Have faith in Elohim (God).
live.canon|mark|11:23: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be you removed, and be you cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he says shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he says.
live.canon|mark|11:3: And if any man say unto you, Why do you this? say you that the Lord has need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
live.canon|mark|12:10: And have you not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
live.canon|mark|12:24: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto them, Do you not therefore err, because you know not the scriptures, neither the power of Elohim (God)?
live.canon|mark|12:26: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have you not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush Elohim (God) spake unto him, saying, I am the Elohim (God) of Abraham, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac, and the Elohim (God) of Jacob?
live.canon|mark|12:27: He is not the Elohim (God) of the dead, but the Elohim (God) of the living: you therefore do greatly err.
live.canon|mark|12:30: And you shall love Yahuah Elohayka (the Lord thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength: this is the first commandment.
live.canon|mark|12:31: And the second is like, namely this, You shall love your neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
live.canon|mark|12:32: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, you have said the truth: for there is one Elohim (God); and there is none other but he:
live.canon|mark|12:34: And when Yahusha (Jesus) saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, You are not far from the kingdom of Elohim (God). And no man after that durst ask him any question.
live.canon|mark|12:36: For David himself said by the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), Yahuah (LORD) said to my Lord, Sit you on my right hand, till I make your enemies your footstool.
live.canon|mark|12:43: And he called unto him his disciples, and says unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow has cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
live.canon|mark|12:1: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
live.canon|mark|12:2: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
live.canon|mark|12:3: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
live.canon|mark|12:4: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
live.canon|mark|12:5: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
live.canon|mark|12:6: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
live.canon|mark|12:7: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
live.canon|mark|12:8: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
live.canon|mark|12:9: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
live.canon|mark|12:11: This was Yahuah's (Lord’s) doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
live.canon|mark|12:12: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
live.canon|mark|12:13: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
live.canon|mark|12:17: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto them, Render to Cæsar the things that are Cæsar’s, and to Elohim (God) the things that are Elohim's (God’s). And they marvelled at him.
live.canon|mark|12:18: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
live.canon|mark|12:14: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that you are true, and carest for no man: for you regard not the person of men, but teach the way of Elohim (God) in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Cæsar, or not?
live.canon|mark|12:15: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt you me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
live.canon|mark|12:19: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man’s brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
live.canon|mark|12:20: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
live.canon|mark|12:21: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
live.canon|mark|12:22: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
live.canon|mark|12:23: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
live.canon|mark|12:25: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
live.canon|mark|12:28: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
live.canon|mark|12:29: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel); Yahuah Eloheinu (The Lord our God) is one Yahuah (Lord):
live.canon|mark|12:33: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
live.canon|mark|12:35: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Messiah (Christ) is the Son of David?
live.canon|mark|12:38: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
live.canon|mark|12:39: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
live.canon|mark|12:40: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
live.canon|mark|12:41: And Yahusha (Jesus) sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
live.canon|mark|12:42: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
live.canon|mark|12:44: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
live.canon|mark|12:16: And they brought it. And he says unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Cæsar’s.
live.canon|mark|12:37: David therefore himself calls him the Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
live.canon|mark|13:1: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples says unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
live.canon|mark|13:2: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto him, See you these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
live.canon|mark|13:7: And when you shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be you not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
live.canon|mark|13:9: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues you shall be beaten: and you shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
live.canon|mark|13:11: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what you shall speak, neither do you premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak you: for it is not you that speak, but the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
live.canon|mark|13:13: And you shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
live.canon|mark|13:14: But when you shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judæa flee to the mountains:
live.canon|mark|13:20: And except that Yahuah (Lord) had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect’s sake, whom he has chosen, he has shortened the days.
live.canon|mark|13:23: But take you heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
live.canon|mark|13:28: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and puts forth leaves, you know that summer is near:
live.canon|mark|13:29: So you in like manner, when you shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
live.canon|mark|13:32: But of that day and that hour knows no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
live.canon|mark|13:33: Take you heed, watch and pray: for you know not when the time is.
live.canon|mark|13:35: Watch you therefore: for you know not when the master of the house comes, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
live.canon|mark|13:3: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
live.canon|mark|13:4: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
live.canon|mark|13:5: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
live.canon|mark|13:6: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Messiah (Christ); and shall deceive many.
live.canon|mark|13:8: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
live.canon|mark|13:10: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
live.canon|mark|13:12: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
live.canon|mark|13:15: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
live.canon|mark|13:16: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
live.canon|mark|13:17: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
live.canon|mark|13:19: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which Elohim (God) created unto this time, neither shall be.
live.canon|mark|13:21: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Messiah (Christ); or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
live.canon|mark|13:22: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
live.canon|mark|13:24: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
live.canon|mark|13:25: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
live.canon|mark|13:26: And then shall they see the Son of Adam coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
live.canon|mark|13:27: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
live.canon|mark|13:30: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
live.canon|mark|13:31: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
live.canon|mark|13:34: For the Son of Adam is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
live.canon|mark|13:36: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
live.canon|mark|13:37: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
live.canon|mark|13:18: And pray you that your flight be not in the winter.
live.canon|mark|14:6: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, Let her alone; why trouble you her? she has wrought a good work on me.
live.canon|mark|14:7: For you have the poor with you always, and whensoever you will you may do them good: but me you have not always.
live.canon|mark|14:8: She has done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
live.canon|mark|14:9: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she has done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
live.canon|mark|14:12: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where will you that we go and prepare that you may eat the passover?
live.canon|mark|14:13: And he sends forth two of his disciples, and says unto them, Go you into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
live.canon|mark|14:14: And wheresoever he shall go in, say you to the goodman of the house, The Master says, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
live.canon|mark|14:17: And in the evening he comes with the twelve.
live.canon|mark|14:18: And as they sat and did eat, Yahusha (Jesus) said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eats with me shall betray me.
live.canon|mark|14:33: And he takes with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
live.canon|mark|14:34: And says unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry you here, and watch.
live.canon|mark|14:36: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto you; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what you will.
live.canon|mark|14:37: And he comes, and finds them sleeping, and says unto Peter, Simon, sleepest you? could not you watch one hour?
live.canon|mark|14:38: Watch you and pray, lest you enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
live.canon|mark|14:41: And he comes the third time, and says unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of Adam is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
live.canon|mark|14:43: And immediately, while he yet spake, comes Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
live.canon|mark|14:45: And as soon as he was come, he goes straightway to him, and says, Master, master; and kissed him.

live.canon|mark|14:55: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Yahusha (Jesus) to put him to death; and found none.

live.canon|mark|15:13: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
live.canon|mark|15:15: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Yahusha (Jesus), when he had scourged him, to be crucified.

live.canon|mark|15:18: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Yahudim (Jews)!
live.canon|mark|15:19: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
live.canon|mark|15:20: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
live.canon|mark|15:21: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
live.canon|mark|15:22: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
live.canon|mark|15:23: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
live.canon|mark|15:24: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

live.canon|mark|15:39: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of Elohim (God).
live.canon|mark|15:40: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
live.canon|mark|15:41: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
live.canon|mark|15:42: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
live.canon|mark|15:43: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of Elohim (God), came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|mark|15:44: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
live.canon|mark|15:45: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

live.canon|mark|16:6: And he says unto them, Be not affrighted: You seek Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
live.canon|mark|16:7: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goes before you into Galilee: there shall you see him, as he said unto you.
live.canon|mark|16:15: And he said unto them, Go you into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

live.canon|mark|16:1: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
live.canon|mark|16:2: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
live.canon|mark|16:3: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
live.canon|mark|16:4: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
live.canon|mark|16:5: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
live.canon|mark|16:8: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
live.canon|mark|16:9: Now when Yahusha (Jesus) was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
live.canon|mark|16:10: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
live.canon|mark|16:11: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
live.canon|mark|16:12: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
live.canon|mark|16:13: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
live.canon|mark|16:14: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
live.canon|mark|16:17: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
live.canon|mark|16:18: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
live.canon|mark|16:19: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of Elohim (God).
live.canon|mark|16:20: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.

live.canon|matthew|4:22: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.

live.canon|matthew|11:9: But what went you out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.

live.canon|matthew|11:21: Woe unto you, Chorazin! woe unto you, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
