live.canon|matthew|18:9: And if your eye offend you, pluck it out, and cast it from you: it is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
live.canon|matthew|18:17: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto you as an heathen man and a publican.
live.canon|matthew|18:18: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|18:22: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, I say not unto you, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
live.canon|matthew|18:28: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that you owest.
live.canon|matthew|18:29: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay you all.
live.canon|matthew|18:32: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O you wicked servant, I forgave you all that debt, because you desiredst me:
live.canon|matthew|18:33: Should not you also have had compassion on your fellowservant, even as I had pity on you?
live.canon|matthew|18:35: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if you from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
live.canon|matthew|18:1: At the same time came the disciples unto Yahusha (Jesus), saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
live.canon|matthew|18:2: And Yahusha (Jesus) called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
live.canon|matthew|18:4: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
live.canon|matthew|18:6: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
live.canon|matthew|18:11: For the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost.
live.canon|matthew|18:14: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
live.canon|matthew|18:10: Take heed that you despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|18:12: How think you? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, does he not leave the ninety and nine, and goes into the mountains, and seeks that which is gone astray?
live.canon|matthew|18:19: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|18:20: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
live.canon|matthew|18:23: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
live.canon|matthew|18:24: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
live.canon|matthew|18:25: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
live.canon|matthew|18:27: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
live.canon|matthew|18:30: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
live.canon|matthew|18:31: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
live.canon|matthew|18:34: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
live.canon|matthew|18:13: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoices more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
live.canon|matthew|18:15: Moreover if your brother shall trespass against you, go and tell him his fault between you and him alone: if he shall hear you, you have gained your brother.
live.canon|matthew|18:16: But if he will not hear you, then take with you one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
live.canon|matthew|18:26: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay you all.
live.canon|matthew|18:21: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
live.canon|matthew|19:4: And he answered and said unto them, Have you not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
live.canon|matthew|19:6: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore Elohim (God) has joined together, let not man put asunder.
live.canon|matthew|19:8: He says unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
live.canon|matthew|19:9: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, commits adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away does commit adultery.
live.canon|matthew|19:21: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, If you will be perfect, go and sell that you have, and give to the poor, and you shall have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
live.canon|matthew|19:27: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed you; what shall we have therefore?
live.canon|matthew|19:28: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That you which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, you also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|matthew|19:29: And every one that has forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
live.canon|matthew|19:1: And it came to pass, that when Yahusha (Jesus) had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
live.canon|matthew|19:2: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
live.canon|matthew|19:3: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
live.canon|matthew|19:5: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
live.canon|matthew|19:7: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
live.canon|matthew|19:10: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
live.canon|matthew|19:11: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
live.canon|matthew|19:12: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
live.canon|matthew|19:13: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
live.canon|matthew|19:14: But Yahusha (Jesus) said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
live.canon|matthew|19:15: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
live.canon|matthew|19:16: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
live.canon|matthew|19:22: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
live.canon|matthew|19:17: And he said unto him, Why callest you me good? there is none good but one, that is, Elohim (God): but if you will enter into life, keep the commandments.
live.canon|matthew|19:18: He says unto him, Which? Yahusha (Jesus) said, You shall do no murder, You shall not commit adultery, You shall not steal, You shall not bear false witness,
live.canon|matthew|19:19: Honour your father and your mother: and, You shall love your neighbour as thyself.
live.canon|matthew|19:20: The young man says unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
live.canon|matthew|19:23: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
live.canon|matthew|19:24: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God).
live.canon|matthew|19:25: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
live.canon|matthew|19:26: But Yahusha (Jesus) beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible.
live.canon|matthew|19:30: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
live.canon|matthew|21:16: And said unto him, Hear you what these say? And Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Yea; have you never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings you have perfected praise?
live.canon|matthew|21:19: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on you henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
live.canon|matthew|21:21: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If you have faith, and doubt not, you shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if you shall say unto this mountain, Be you removed, and be you cast into the sea; it shall be done.
live.canon|matthew|21:22: And all things, whatsoever you shall ask in prayer, believing, you shall receive.
live.canon|matthew|21:23: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority do you these things? and who gave you this authority?
live.canon|matthew|21:24: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if you tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
live.canon|matthew|21:25: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did you not then believe him?
live.canon|matthew|21:28: But what think you? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
live.canon|matthew|21:32: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and you believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and you, when you had seen it, repented not afterward, that you might believe him.
live.canon|matthew|21:42: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Did you never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is Yahuah's (Lord’s) doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
live.canon|matthew|21:2: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway you shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
live.canon|matthew|21:1: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Yahusha (Jesus) two disciples,
live.canon|matthew|21:4: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
live.canon|matthew|21:6: And the disciples went, and did as Yahusha (Jesus) commanded them,
live.canon|matthew|21:7: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
live.canon|matthew|21:8: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
live.canon|matthew|21:10: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
live.canon|matthew|21:11: And the multitude said, This is Yahusha (Jesus) the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
live.canon|matthew|21:12: And Yahusha (Jesus) went into the temple of Elohim (God), and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
live.canon|matthew|21:14: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

members.member_note: The substantial-substance-of-the-two-sticks-united-substance.
The Twelve sent out at Luke 9 — the same commissioning architecture as Matthew 10, working out the gathering of the scattered seed first through Yashar'eli (Israelite) territory.

*And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of Elohim (God)* (Luke 13:29) — the four-winds gathering language. NOT the inherited Gentile-inclusion gospel; the prophetic-gathering of the scattered seed of Yashar'el (Israel) from the territories of dispersion. Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 43:5-6 substance.

The *among all nations, beginning at Yerushalayim (Jerusalem)* (v.47) is panta-ta-ethnē-as-SCOPE-of-proclamation language — the same gathering-of-the-scattered-from-every-nation substance the Matt 28 commission carries. The *beginning at Yerushalayim* is the gathering-out-of-Yahudah-first register; the *all nations* is the territories-of-the-scattered, not the categorical-Gentile-inclusion.

Luke 24:44 — *that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.* Luke has Yahusha (Jesus) point the disciples to the law, the prophets and the psalms before he sends them to preach among all nations.
*I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles* (Yeshayahu/Isaiah 49:6).
*Ye are the sons of the living Elohim* (Hoshea/Hosea 1:10) — the scattered seed addressed.
*The gospel must first be published among all nations.* *Panta ta ethnē* as the territory-of-the-scattered-seed, not the categorical-three-categories audience.
Matthew 28:19's Great Commission — same scope.
*I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles* (Yeshayahu/Isaiah 49:6).
*Ye are the sons of the living Elohim (God)* (Hoshea/Hosea 1:10).
*Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.* The all-the-world scope is the territory-of-the-scattered-seed.
*My sheep hear my voice* (Yochanan/John 10:27).

*The disciples going forth, the Lord working with them.* The Markan ending names the apostolic walk that Acts opens into (Acts 14:3). (NT-Lord rule: titular for ascended Yahusha — *Lord* preserved per S182 §7.)
Acts 19:11-12's signs-and-wonders confirming the apostolic word.
Hebrews 2:3-4's *Elohim (God) also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders*.

Mark 16:14 — *upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.* Mark has the risen one rebuke the eleven for unbelief at table and then send them into all the world.
*Go ... rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)* — `lost-sheep-mission-scope`.
*I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)*.
Galilee-of-the-goyim per Yeshayahu 9:1-2 — the territories-of-the-scattered-seed.
*Yahuah shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people ... from the four corners of the earth.*

threads.title: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations — all power given him, and the sheep sought where they were scattered (Matthew 10 and 15; Hosea 1; Isaiah 11; James 1)
threads.summary_md:
It ain't new. The risen one sends the eleven with a word about power and a word about nations:

*And Yahusha (Jesus) came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* (Matthew 28:18)

*Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):* (Matthew 28:19)

*All power is given unto me*: given, by the Father, and Daniel had already seen the giving:

*And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* (Daniel 7:14)

Then *all nations*. Before his death the sending had a fence on it, and he told the twelve who they were sent to:

*These twelve Yahusha (Jesus) sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:* (Matthew 10:5)

*But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 10:6)

*But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 15:24)

The sheep did not change after the rising; the fence came down, because the sheep were out past it. The prophets had said where the lost sheep of the house were: in the nations, under another name, waiting to be called sons again:

*Yet the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living Elohim (God).* (Hosea 1:10)

*And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.* (Isaiah 11:11)

*And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.* (Isaiah 11:12)

*And say unto them, Thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:* (Ezekiel 37:21)

Paul quotes Hosea's verse for the ones he was sent to:

*And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living Elohim (God).* (Romans 9:26)

And the letters are addressed to the same people in the same places. James writes to the tribes, Peter to the scattered:

*James, a servant of Elohim (God) and of the Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ), to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.* (James 1:1)

*Peter, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,* (1 Peter 1:1)

*All nations* is where the sheep are, not who the sheep are. The errand is the one errand, the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), now sought in every place they were driven to, because the death that frees the divorced house has been died. The nations themselves come up to the mountain in the reign, to be taught, and that is a different hour and a different verse:

*And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of Yahuah (LORD), and to the house of the Elohim (God) of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of Yahuah (LORD) from Jerusalem.* (Micah 4:2)

The gospel of the kingdom goes to all nations for a witness, and the end comes when the sheep in them have heard:

*And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.* (Matthew 24:14)
